factSources.text: Mars describes action, drive, heat, conflict, courage, desire, and the instinct to move toward what is wanted. It shows how someone fights, initiates, protects, reacts, and uses energy when something needs to happen. Mars takes close to two years to move through all twelve signs, with retrograde periods that slow or redirect momentum. Its sign describes the style of action; its house shows where pressure, effort, and courage become active. You act with intensity and a strong will. Your actions are often guided by your deep intuition, and you’re not afraid to explore the hidden depths of any situation.
